blocks.text: 33. And just as through a disobedient virgin man was stricken down and fell into death, so through the Virgin who was obedient to the Word of God man was reanimated and received life. [^irenaeus-demonstration-iv-83] For the Lord came to seek again the sheep that was lost; [^irenaeus-demonstration-iv-84] and man it was that was lost: and for this cause there was not made some other formation, [^irenaeus-demonstration-iv-85] but in that same which had its descent from Adam He preserved the likeness of the (first) formation. [^irenaeus-demonstration-iv-86] For it was necessary that Adam should be summed up in Christ, that mortality might be swallowed up and overwhelmed by immortality; and Eve summed up in Mary, that a virgin should be a virgin’s intercessor, [^irenaeus-demonstration-iv-87] and by a virgin’s obedience undo and put away the disobedience of a virgin.

irenaeus-demonstration-iv-83.text: The same parallel is worked out in III, xxxii. 1, and V, xix. 1. It is found earlier in Justin Martyr ( Dial . 100), and later in Tertullian ( De carne Chr. 17).

irenaeus-demonstration-iv-84.text: Irenæus is fond of referring to the sheep that was lost: see III, xx. 3, xxxii. 2, xxxvii. 1; V, xii. 3, xv. 2

irenaeus-demonstration-iv-85.text: V, xiv. 2: “ Nunc autem quod fuit qui perierat homo, hoc salutare factum est Verbum . . . non alteram quandam, sed illam principalem Patris plasmationem in se recapitulans, exquirens id quod perierat. ”

irenaeus-demonstration-iv-87.text: III, xxxii. I: “ eam quæ est a Maria in Evam recirculationem significans ;” V, xix. 1: “ uti virginis Evæ virgo Maria fieret advocata. ” Cf Just. M. Dial. 100.
